note: Every value below is a published figure transcribed or extracted by HPI desk research. None is an HPI study outcome, an individual eligibility assessment or evidence of impact. Missing provenance fields are declared explicitly in missingProvenance; HPI never fills them with guesses.

facts.label: Households modelled as eligible for Pension Credit (all eligible)
facts.populationDefinition: Pension-age households modelled by DWP as eligible for Pension Credit, whether or not in receipt
facts.sourceVersion: ODS workbook, worksheet 3a, physical row 109, column C
facts.licence: OGL-3.0 subject to exceptions for third-party content
facts.transformation: Value read from the official ODS binary with scripts/verify_newham_dwp_ods.py (Python standard library); recorded exactly as published (rounded).
facts.uncertainty: Rounded modelled estimate. No confidence interval is published in the extracted table; DWP notes row totals may differ from underlying estimates.
facts.missingness: The table does not publish applications or approvals, so the application and approval stages cannot be described for Newham from this source.
facts.limitations: Ecological model of potential eligibility, not verified individual entitlement or a count of HPI participants.
facts.interpretationGuard: Not comparable with the Great Britain FYE2025 survey-based take-up estimate.

facts.label: Eligible households modelled as in receipt of Pension Credit
facts.populationDefinition: Pension-age households modelled as eligible and in receipt of Pension Credit
facts.sourceVersion: ODS workbook, worksheet 3a, physical row 109, column E
facts.licence: OGL-3.0 subject to exceptions for third-party content
facts.transformation: Value read from the official ODS binary with scripts/verify_newham_dwp_ods.py; recorded exactly as published (rounded).
facts.uncertainty: Rounded modelled estimate; no published interval in the extracted table.
facts.missingness: Receipt is modelled for 2023/24 only; no current 2026 local figure.
facts.limitations: Administrative model at household level; does not show whether receipt improved household security.
facts.interpretationGuard: Receipt is not sustained economic improvement.

facts.label: Households modelled as potentially eligible but not in receipt
facts.populationDefinition: Pension-age households modelled as potentially eligible for Pension Credit and not receiving it
facts.sourceVersion: ODS workbook, worksheet 3a, physical row 109, column D
facts.licence: OGL-3.0 subject to exceptions for third-party content
facts.transformation: Value read from the official ODS binary with scripts/verify_newham_dwp_ods.py; recorded exactly as published (rounded).
facts.uncertainty: Rounded modelled estimate; no published interval in the extracted table.
facts.missingness: Reasons for non-receipt (ineligibility error, unawareness, burden, choice) are not published.
facts.limitations: A modelled gap is not a list of people and must never be used to contact individuals.
facts.interpretationGuard: Not a count of people HPI could or should approach.

facts.label: Modelled caseload receipt rate
facts.populationDefinition: Eligible households in receipt divided by all eligible households (DWP local model)
facts.sourceVersion: ODS workbook, worksheet 3a, physical row 109, column F
facts.licence: OGL-3.0 subject to exceptions for third-party content
facts.transformation: Rate recorded as published. HPI checks consistency with the published rounded numerator and denominator (8,800 / 11,300 = 77.9%, consistent with 78% after rounding).
facts.uncertainty: Rounded modelled rate; no published interval in the extracted table.
facts.missingness: No time series in this extract.
facts.limitations: Local administrative model rate, not survey-based take-up and not verified individual receipt.
facts.interpretationGuard: Never compare directly with the Great Britain 62% FYE2025 survey estimate.

facts.label: Modelled expenditure receipt rate
facts.populationDefinition: Estimated amount claimed by eligible households in receipt relative to estimated total entitlement (DWP local model)
facts.sourceVersion: ODS workbook, worksheet 3b, physical row 110, column E
facts.licence: OGL-3.0 subject to exceptions for third-party content
facts.transformation: Rate recorded as published. Amount columns are not used because the worksheet header unit (£m) conflicts with the displayed raw values.
facts.uncertainty: Rounded modelled rate; no published interval in the extracted table.
facts.missingness: Numerator and denominator amounts are withheld because their units are not independently reconciled.
facts.limitations: An expenditure rate is a different measure from the caseload rate and cannot be used as an HPI cost or impact figure.
facts.interpretationGuard: Do not present 86% and 78% as the same statistic.

missingProvenance.reason: Amount units in worksheet 3b are inconsistent with its header; HPI does not rescale them silently.
Amount units in worksheet 3b are inconsistent with its header; HPI does not rescale them silently.

facts.label: Residents supported to claim Pension Credit by the council service (self-reported)
facts.populationDefinition: Residents supported by the Our Newham Money service to claim Pension Credit
facts.uncertainty: Self-reported service output; no verification of awards.
facts.missingness: Unique confirmed awards and eligible denominator not supplied.
facts.limitations: Support to claim is a service output, not proof of award, eligibility or causal additionality; sub-cohorts may overlap other council publications.
facts.interpretationGuard: Not an application, approval or receipt stage measure, and not HPI activity.

facts.label: Additional income attributed by the council to supported Pension Credit claims (self-reported)
facts.populationDefinition: Same council programme report as the 220 claim-support output
facts.uncertainty: Self-reported total; temporal basis (annualised or not) not confirmed.
facts.missingness: Counterfactual, audit and cost information not supplied.
facts.limitations: Neither HPI impact nor audited incremental welfare. Do not divide by 220 as a validated average.
